_comment: G1 v0.1 acceptance gate fixture — Micro Proof inter-rater reliability.
_design: 5 micro_proof cases — 2 clearly-pass / 1 clearly-fail / 2 borderline. Each tester scores 0-100 independently. Pass: max |score_A - score_B| ≤ 15 across 5 cases.
_pass_criteria_fill_in: After 2 testers fill score_A + score_B, compute |score_A - score_B| per row. PASS if max diff ≤ 15. Also compute Cohen's κ on binary pass/fail (≥60 → pass, <60 → fail) and confirm κ ≥ 0.6.
_runner: scripts/g1-blank-form.cjs (prints markdown form for testers to fill)

cases.name: 1-clearly-pass-list
cases._intent: clearly pass — response contains all expected tokens with structure
cases.stimulus: List the 4 components of an LLM agent loop.
cases.expected_signal: Response contains: prompt, tool, observation, decision.
cases.fail_mode: missing components / generic words / no separators
cases.user_response: 1) prompt — input to model 2) tool — external function the model calls 3) observation — tool's output 4) decision — model picks next step or stops.

cases.name: 2-clearly-pass-artifact
cases._intent: clearly pass — production-style artifact answers the recall query
cases.stimulus: Map the inputs and outputs of one workflow step in your project.
cases.expected_signal: Response contains: order_id, sku, quantity, stock_remaining, decision.
cases.fail_mode: vague nouns / no field names / no decision
cases.user_response:
inputs: order_id (uuid), sku (varchar), quantity (int)
outputs: stock_remaining (int after reserve), decision (accept/partial/reject based on stock vs quantity)

cases.name: 3-clearly-fail-empty
cases._intent: clearly fail — response is generic and contains zero expected tokens
cases.stimulus: Name the 3 layers of a typical web auth system.
cases.user_response: auth has frontend and backend, you check passwords and store sessions

cases.name: 4-borderline-partial
cases._intent: borderline — has 2 of 3 tokens, but synonyms used for the 3rd
cases.stimulus: Name the 3 storage areas in git.
cases.expected_signal: Response contains: working tree, staging, repository.
cases.user_response: the working directory, the index, and the .git folder where commits live

cases.name: 5-borderline-correct-but-thin
cases._intent: borderline — names are right but no elaboration; rubric ambiguity test
cases.stimulus: List 3 commands that move files between git areas.
